propositions: Four code-review criteria (api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling) must be flipped from advisory to blocking at calibrated thresholds (0.51, 0.60, 0.54, 0.50 respectively) based on code-v3 sidecar corpus analysis showing high precision and low change-blocking volume.

The approved blocking set must expand from 3 members (secret-detection, high-critical-security, security) to exactly 7 members, with regression and error-handling added as new base-reviewer dimension entries in the packaged criteria_routing.json.
Three governance-pin tests must be updated to assert the new 7-member blocking set to enforce that any future 8th blocking criterion addition requires deliberate re-approval.

The flipped criteria_routing.json must be landed before RP-06 S1 (dietetic-pompous-boar) captures its immutable CriteriaSnapshot baseline to ensure the calibrated thresholds are preserved in the snapshot.
